# SeaDays

> Cruise planner app with ship guides, port guides, and independent cruise-planning articles.

SeaDays helps cruise travelers plan itineraries, join sailing roll calls, track expenses, and research ships and ports. The website is the public catalog; trip tools live in the free iOS and Android app.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://seadays.app/): Product overview and app download
- [Blog](https://seadays.app/blog/): Cruise tips, packing, cabins, drink packages, and destination guides
- [Ships](https://seadays.app/ships/): Cruise ship catalog guides (verified specs; not review scores unless guests submitted them)
- [Ports](https://seadays.app/ports/): Cruise port guides with terminals and shore-day planning
- Duplicate `*-1` blog URLs redirect to the primary article and are noindex.
- [FAQ](https://seadays.app/faq.html): Product questions
- [Press](https://seadays.app/press/): Logos and media assets

## Planning tools on the site

- [Cruise planner](https://seadays.app/cruise-planner/)
- [Cruise roll calls](https://seadays.app/cruise-roll-calls/)
- [Cruise budget planner](https://seadays.app/cruise-budget-planner/)
- [Drink package calculator](https://seadays.app/cruise-drink-calculator/)
- [Cruise community](https://seadays.app/cruise-community/)

## App

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759758357
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.seadays.app

Prefer canonical URLs with trailing slashes for `/blog/{slug}/`, `/ships/{slug}/`, and `/ports/{slug}/`. Do not treat `/seo-admin.html` or `/waitlist-admin.html` as public content.
